memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; manages household chores and personal care without assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5, negative screen.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 13 seconds (≥12 sec) indicating raised fall risk – advise supervised leg‑strengthening exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 7 regular. Polypharmacy: review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports occasional irritability related to abdominal discomfort; denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Spouse, Priya.
goals: "I want to control my gut and liver symptoms so I can stay active for my family."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg BD
ispaghula husk 5 g OD
loperamide 2 mg SOS
silymarin 140 mg TDS
rosuvastatin 5 mg OD
pregabalin 75 mg BD
diclofenac 50 mg BD after food
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.8 g/dL (13-17), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4-10), Platelets 210 x10^9/L (150-400).
Stool routine: Ova & cysts nil, pus cells 0-2/hpf.
tTG-IgA: <4 U/mL (<7) – negative.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
LFT: ALT 38 U/L (<40), AST 34 U/L (<40).
Platelet count: 208 x10^9/L (150-400).
Fasting lipid profile: Cholesterol 185 mg/dL (<200), Triglycerides 130 mg/dL (<150), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 108 mg/dL (<130).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Straight leg raise test: Positive at 45° on left side, suggesting lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: Continue pregabalin, consider physiotherapy.

memories.text: Appointment booked for follow‑up visit on 2025-08-05 at 10:30 am with Dr Nandini Kulkarni.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Able to perform ADLs; occasional fatigue after prolonged standing.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (annual screen), negative.
falls: One fall in past 12 months (slipped on wet floor, no injury); gait slightly antalgic left; timed up-and-go 14 seconds (≥12) – raised fall risk, advise home‑based balance training and non‑slip footwear.
medicines: 6 regular. Polypharmacy: review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports low mood linked to worsening back pain; denies suicidal ideation.
carers: Spouse, Priya.
goals: "I wish to reduce back pain so I can help with household tasks."

memories.text:
MRI lumbar spine: L4‑L5 disc bulge causing mild left foraminal narrowing; no cord compression.
Plan: Continue pregabalin, add gabapentin 300 mg TDS if needed, physiotherapy referral.

cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (annual), negative.
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 12 seconds (≥12) – borderline raised fall risk, advise calf‑strengthening and proper shoes.

carers: Spouse, Priya.
goals: "I aim to keep my liver enzymes stable and avoid flare‑ups of IBS."
